Name: Precious Krobus Portraits and Sprites
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
The modception has begun! This is my mod to add humanoid Krobus portraits and sprites to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22938]Nyapu's Portraits for Seasonal Outfits[/url] which adds [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits Inspired by Dong[/url] to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]. My ADHD really needs to chill with these mod setups. ^^; [s]There's also a completely standalone version if you aren't using other portrait/sprite mods that affect Krobus.[/s] (The mod now has just one download that's compatible as standalone or with other portrait mods like Seasonal Outfits and Nyapu's!)

This replaces all sprites and portraits for Krobus, including his purple trenchcoat outfit, the sea monster scene, and the random flying Crowbus. (ﾉ´ヮ`)ﾉ*: ･ﾟ I'm pretty sure I got all instances of him covered, but if anything is missing, please let me know!



[b][u]To install:[/u][/b][size=2]

1. Download and unzip the folder. Drop the folder "[CP] Precious Krobus" into StardewValley/mods. Done!


Thanks to [b][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/1249127-dolphinisnotafish/]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url][/b] for simplifying the mod's files for me! I really appreciate the help! ⸜(*ˊᗜˋ*)⸝ I still have a lot to learn about the coding side of mods, but I'm excited to someday get better at it! lol


[b]Old instructions are condensed here. Disregard these if you're using the new version![/b]
[spoiler]
[b]For use with Nyapu's Portraits Inspired by Dong[/b]:

1. Download and unzip [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits Inspired By Dong[/url]. Drop the folder "[CP] Nyapu's Portraits" into StardewValley/mods.

2. Download and unzip Precious Krobus for Nyapu's Portraits. Open the folder to see two files inside, "[CP] Nyapu's Portraits" and "[CP] Precious Krobus". Drop them both into StardewValley/mods. Replace files when asked. Done!



[b]For use with Nyapu's Portraits + Seasonal Outfits[/b] :

1. Download and unzip [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits Inspired By Dong[/url]. Drop the folder "[CP] Nyapu's Portraits" into StardewValley/mods.

2. Download and unzip [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿ (download the Legacy version under optional files instead of the main version to avoid portrait discrepancies). Drop the folder "[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters Legacy" into StardewValley/mods. Rename the file and remove Legacy, so it reads "[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters".

3. Download and unzip [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22938]Nyapu's Portraits for Seasonal Outfits - Color Edit[/url]. Open the folder and drop both files "[CP] Nyapu's Portraits" and "[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters" into StardewValley/mods. Replace files when asked.

4. Download and unzip Precious Krobus for Nyapu's Portraits - Seasonal Legacy. Open the folder and drop both files "[CP] Precious Krobus" and "[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters" into StardewValley/mods. Finally, done![/size]
[/spoiler]
